description:
PROPOSED INSTALLATION OF SOLAR PANELS ON ROOF OF THE
PROPERTY AND X 1 HEAT PUMP OUTDOOR UNIT WITH AN ACOUSTIC ENCLOSURE AT
GROUND FLOOR REAR GARDEN.
decision_conditions: <p>Noise level, (expressed as the equivalent continuous sound level) from the new heat pump plant unit shall comply with the sound levels and mitigation measures contained in the plant noise impact assessment by Parker Jones Acoustics dated 16 January 2026.</p><p>Reason: To protect the amenities of those in the local vicinity.</p>
